text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
One day during the holiday season, I'm
having a
meeting with Silence Suzuka
when she notices the
snow falling
outside.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Gasp! It's snowing!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Yes, it reminds me of home. It snows a
lot there.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: And... I love the way it absorbs sound.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. Just like I thought, the air is so
fresh. Ahh,
it feels like home.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Running in the snow feels so good.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Yes. You know, snow is actually the
reason I grew
to love running so much.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I ask her to tell me more.
choice_data_list: （彼女が、走り出したきっかけ……！）

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
When I was a child, I was enchanted by
the
tranquility of this snowfield and
decided to try
running through it.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Eventually, all I could hear was the
sound of my
own heartbeat. It was so
quiet, and all I could see
was white. I
was suddenly struck by the beauty of
it
all.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
I felt like I had the whole world all to
myself.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
I think it was then that I became so
taken with
running.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Every Umamusume has their own reason
for
running, but Silence Suzuka's feels
particularly
unique.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Her desire to take in that scenery is
genuine.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: "Together..."
choice_data_list: 気が済むまで、一緒に世界を独り占めしよう

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Hehe. Yes, let's do it!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: We decide to take a walk in the snow.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Seeing her staring out into the snow, I
ask her
what's on her mind.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
All this snow... It's perfect for the
holidays, don't
you think?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She seems to consider something after
hearing my
answer. Suddenly, she strides
out into the snow.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Hehe, well, 'tis the season.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She crouches down and begins sculpting
a little
bunny out of snow.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
I used to make these every now and
then.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
It's nothing special, but... please think of
it as my
present to you.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Happy holidays, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
This special day with Silence Suzuka has
turned
out to be one I'll remember for a
long time to
come.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Hehe.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
I was just thinking that stump over there
looks
like a log cake.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
It's that time of year again, isn't it? I
haven't
thought about it until now.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Um... Why don't we have some cake to
celebrate?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
If you like, maybe we could make a log
cake
together.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
We make a trip to the store to buy the

ingredients for our cake, and bring
everything
back to my office.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Does the frosting look like wood to you?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Thank you!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Hehe, that's way too many strawberries.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
This special day with Silence Suzuka has
turned
out to be one I'll remember for a
long time to
come.
